subject: Post-demo follow-up: procurement & security next steps (Acme Fintech)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@acmefintech.com>, Sophie Liang <sophie.liang@acmefintech.com>, Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@acmefintech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T10:00:00-08:00
Subject: Post-demo follow-up: procurement & security next steps (Acme Fintech)

Hi Ethan / Sophie / Carlos —

Thanks again for taking the demo today — really appreciated the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum: 

Recap (30-min demo):
- Showed throughput/latency profile for your 500 concurrent users workload and sample prompts.
- Reviewed data residency options (US-east, dedicated VPC) and our SOC2 scope.
- Discussed pricing bands for hosted vs dedicated capacity and estimated monthly spend.

Open items / asks from your side:
1) Stakeholder mapping — confirmation of economic buyer (you mentioned Ethan), security reviewer(s) (Sophie), and procurement contact (Carlos). Please confirm if there are any other stakeholders we should loop in (legal, IT ops, compliance).
2) Procurement path / timeline — Carlos, can you share your vendor onboarding steps, key docs you need (W-9, DUNS, insurance certs), and PO timing?
3) Security artifacts — Sophie, we'll share our SOC2 report, architecture diagram, and the security questionnaire. Are there any additional requirements (encryption at rest keys/KMS, logging retention windows)?

Next steps (we propose):
- I'll send the vendor pack (W-9, onboarding guide, commercial summary) for procurement this afternoon.
- Vivek will follow up with a short security appendix and SOC2 snapshot.
- Neha will prepare a formal 3-line commercial summary to support the PO.

Attachment: redwood-onepager.pdf (product + summary).

If this plan looks good, can you confirm: 1) primary PO contact, 2) expected date when procurement will raise a PO, and 3) any legal counsel who should see the T&Cs?

Thanks — will follow up with the vendor pack in a separate email.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0172

From: Sophie Liang <sophie.liang@acmefintech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@acmefintech.com>, Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@acmefintech.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-26T13:18:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: procurement & security next steps (Acme Fintech)

Thanks Marissa — good demo. A few notes from security: 

- Please provide SOC2 Type II (latest) and a network/infra diagram showing where customer data resides.
- We require confirmation of encryption at rest and whether we can use our KMS in the VPC.
- Data retention and audit log retention windows: we currently need 13 months of immutable logs for requests.
- Security questionnaire attached (see security_questionnaire.xlsx) — please fill and return.

Carlos — I’ll need W-9 and DUNS to move vendor setup in parallel with the contract review.

If you can loop in your security owner as well (or Vivek can lead), we can triage the questionnaire items over Slack/short call.

Regards,
Sophie Liang
Head of InfoSec | Acme Fintech
Sophie.Liang@acmefintech.com

From: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@acmefintech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Sophie Liang <sophie.liang@acmefintech.com>
Cc: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@acmefintech.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: procurement & security next steps (Acme Fintech)

Marissa — thanks. A few procurement items and timeline notes: 

- Required for vendor onboarding: W-9, DUNS number, certificate of insurance, primary contact for invoicing, and sample invoice with payment terms.
- We use Workday vendor portal for registration: https://acmefintech.vendorportal.internal/register (I'll start the ticket but we need the W-9 and DUNS to complete).
- Typical internal lead time: once docs are received and legal signs off, procurement raises a PO in ~7-10 business days. If legal requests redlines to our standard MSA, add another 5-7 days.
- For billing: we require electronic invoices (PDF) with PO number. Payment terms: Net 45 by default; exceptions need VP approval.

Can you provide an initial commercial summary (line items and estimated monthly runrate) and a contact email for invoicing? Also confirm whether Redwood can accept ACH and provide bank details if needed.

I'll coordinate with Sophie on security gating items.

Thanks,
Carlos Ruiz
Senior Procurement Manager | Acme Fintech
carlos.ruiz@acmefintech.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@acmefintech.com>, Sophie Liang <sophie.liang@acmefintech.com>, Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@acmefintech.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T11:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up: procurement & security next steps (Acme Fintech)

Carlos / Sophie — great, thanks for the clarity. Attached is our vendor pack and the W-9 (redwood-vendor-pack.pdf, W-9_redwood.pdf). Neha has included an initial commercial summary below to make the PO straightforward.

Commercial summary (for procurement):
- Product: Redwood Hosted API (text generation + embeddings)
- Commitment: Estimated baseline 250k tokens/month, with autoscaling for peak usage.
- Pricing: $X per 1k tokens (hosted); will include three line items on the quote (base commit, overage rate, optional dedicated capacity uplift).
- Billing contact: finance@redwood.com; invoicing: invoices@redwood.com (PDF, attach PO number).
- Payment options: ACH accepted; banking details will be provided on the invoice.

Proposed timeline:
- Today: vendor pack sent to kick off Workday registration.
- By 2026-03-05: formal quote/DocuSign envelope with standard T&Cs for initial 12-month term.
- 2026-03-09 to 2026-03-16: procurement/Legal review window; expect PO by 2026-03-18 if no major redlines.

Vivek — we’ll need the SOC2 snapshot and the answered questionnaire back to Sophie by EOD 03/03 if possible.

Carlos — let me know if you want the commercial summary formatted differently for Workday.

Thanks,
Marissa

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Acme Fintech next steps (prep quote + legal)

Marissa / Vivek — quick internal checklist following the external thread so we’re aligned before sending the DocuSign: 

1) Pricing confirmation: finalize actual line-item numbers and create 3-line quote (base commit, overage, optional dedicated uplift). Deadline: EOD 03/04.
2) Vendor docs: confirm W-9 uploaded to thread and attach DUNS if available.
3) Security artifacts: Vivek to attach SOC2 snapshot + filled security_questionnaire.xlsx by 03/03.
4) Legal: loop Laura to take initial MSA review — ask for minimal redlines and track in the HubSpot deal (https://hubspot.com/deal/RDW-2026-045).
5) Procurement: prepare sample invoice template matching Acme requirements (Net 45 by default).

I'll own the DocuSign envelope prep (commercial summary + standard MSA) once pricing is locked. Marissa — can you confirm the bank details that will go on the invoice or should finance provide final details?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
